mission_prompt: Implement the preservation-first Mac recovery plan: verify exact duplicates, migrate cold archives to streamed Google Drive until at least 150 GiB is free, then run free-first offer research; no unapproved deletion or publishing

failures_repaired.failure: The compound storage-recovery mission fell through to fuzzy matching and selected roi-driven-offer-engineering.
failures_repaired.root_cause: No deterministic preservation-first storage predicate existed; naive substring scoring treated drive inside roi-driven and offer as decisive.
failures_repaired.repair: Added a narrow compound preservation-first storage-recovery predicate with System Audit precedence before the downstream research lane.

failures_repaired.failure: The phrase no unapproved deletion or publishing was treated as a request to publish and blocked safe local work.
failures_repaired.root_cause: Risk detection used raw substrings and had no deny-clause or word-boundary handling.
failures_repaired.repair: Added boundary-safe publish and deletion action families, explicit deny-scope handling, reset words, and mixed-clause regression controls.
